messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: team Dune owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- The image resizer's storage for original uploads doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- As of 2026-03-17, the image resizer keeps original uploads for only 90 days. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19-2]
- As of 2026-03-02, Oskar Lind is on the Ember team's on-call rotation. [valid 2026-03-02 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team's on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-03-02; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call for the Atlas team; Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team this cycle as of 2025-04-03. [decision; valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12; Tomasz is off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Tomasz takes the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, having taken over from Diego. [decision; valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team, having taken over from Oskar Lind. [decision; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-02, Oskar Lind is the primary on-call for the Ember team, not Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-03-02; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team's on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
- Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07. [decision; valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07]

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns image-resizer?

message.reasoning:
The image resizer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-11-26 (valid to now). Today is 2026-06-30.

The Atlas team's primary on-call: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team (valid 2025-07-30 to now). No later entry supersedes it.

So Priya Raman.
